## Relatório de Indicadores QualiÔnibus 2026

Insper Cidades (ONMS) and WRI Brasil, 2026. Benchmarking indicators for bus
systems in Brazilian cities: demand recovery, dedicated lanes, fleet, comfort,
user service, fares, and finances.

[Read the report (PDF)](https://mobilidade.insper.edu.br/2026_relatorio_qualionibus.pdf) ·
[All ONMS publications](https://mobilidade.insper.edu.br/publicacoes)
